King Lear
by William Shakespeare
Directed by Michael Socrates Moran
Presented by Oakland Theater Project

An aging king divides his kingdom among his daughters, setting off a spiral into madness, betrayal, and grief.
Run Time
2 hours 30 minutes with one intermission
